verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents first-party workflow automation: multi-step HR processes such as equipment requests or off-boarding run through custom approval chains, and onboarding can be automated. That is a narrow form of user-defined, event-triggered automation. Auto payroll is a recurring schedule rather than an event trigger, the Payroll AI's alerts are vendor-defined rather than user rules, and Workforce API webhooks are developer building blocks, so none of these earn credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable rule builder (event → condition → action), documented trigger and action types, depth of conditions beyond approval chains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: automate multi-step HR processes like equipment requests or off-boarding with custom approval chains.
From offer letter to day one, everything can be automated so new hires are ready to go.
